title_en: Giving reasons: as, because, etc.; for and with
title_vi: Nêu lý do: as, because v.v.; for và with
theory_html:
A. as, because, seeing that, seeing as, since

We can begin a clause with as, because, seeing that, seeing as, or since to give a reason for a particular situation:

Có thể bắt đầu mệnh đề bằng as, because, seeing that, seeing as hoặc since để nêu lý do cho một tình huống:

  • As it was getting late, I decided I should go home.

    Vì trời đã muộn, tôi quyết định về nhà.

  • We must be near the beach, because I can hear the waves.

    Chắc mình gần bãi biển rồi, vì tôi nghe thấy tiếng sóng.

  • Since he was going to be away on his birthday, we celebrated before he left.

    Vì anh ấy sẽ đi vắng vào ngày sinh nhật, chúng tôi tổ chức trước khi anh đi.

  • We could go and visit Natalia, seeing that we have to drive past her house anyway.

    Mình có thể ghé thăm Natalia, vì đằng nào cũng phải lái xe qua nhà cô ấy.

It is common and acceptable for because to begin a sentence:

Because đứng đầu câu là phổ biến và chấp nhận được:

  • Because everything looked different, I had no idea where to go.

    Vì mọi thứ trông khác hẳn, tôi không biết phải đi đâu.

To give reasons in spoken English, we most often use because. So is also commonly used to express a similar meaning. Compare:

Để nêu lý do trong văn nói, ta thường dùng because nhất. So cũng hay được dùng với nghĩa tương tự. So sánh:

  • Because my mother’s ill, I won’t be able to come. (‘because’ introduces the reason)

    Vì mẹ tôi ốm nên tôi không đến được.

  • My mother’s ill, so I won’t be able to come. (‘so’ introduces the result)

    Mẹ tôi ốm, nên tôi không đến được.

When it means ‘because’, since is rather formal. It is uncommon in conversation, but is frequently used in this way in academic writing:

Khi mang nghĩa ‘vì’, since khá trang trọng. Nó ít dùng trong hội thoại nhưng hay dùng trong văn học thuật:

  • I had to go outside because I was feeling awful. (‘since’ is unlikely in an informal context)

    Tôi phải ra ngoài vì thấy rất khó chịu.

  • The results of this analysis can be easily compared to future observations since satellite coverage will remain continuous.

    Kết quả phân tích này có thể dễ dàng so sánh với các quan sát sau này vì vệ tinh sẽ tiếp tục phủ sóng liên tục.

Seeing that is used in informal English. Some people also use seeing as in informal speech:

Seeing that dùng trong văn thân mật. Một số người cũng dùng seeing as trong văn nói:

  • Joel just had to apologise, seeing that / as he knew he’d made a mistake.

    Joel buộc phải xin lỗi, vì biết mình đã sai.

B. for, in that, inasmuch as

In formal or literary written English we can also introduce a reason in a clause beginning for, in that, or, less commonly, inasmuch as. For is a formal alternative to ‘because’; in that and inasmuch as introduce clauses which clarify what has been said by adding detail:

Trong văn viết trang trọng hoặc văn chương, có thể nêu lý do bằng mệnh đề bắt đầu với for, in that, hoặc ít gặp hơn là inasmuch as. For là dạng trang trọng của ‘because’; in that và inasmuch as mở đầu mệnh đề làm rõ điều vừa nói bằng chi tiết:

  • We must begin planning now, for the future may bring unexpected changes. (not For the future …, we must …)

    Chúng ta phải bắt đầu lập kế hoạch ngay, bởi tương lai có thể mang đến những thay đổi bất ngờ.

  • The film is unusual in that it features only four actors. (or In that …, the film is …)

    Bộ phim khác thường ở chỗ chỉ có bốn diễn viên.

  • Clara and I have quite an easy life, inasmuch as neither of us has to work too hard but we earn quite a lot of money.

    Clara và tôi sống khá thoải mái, ở chỗ không ai phải làm việc quá vất vả mà vẫn kiếm khá nhiều tiền.

C. because of, due to, owing to

The prepositions because of, due to, and owing to can also be used before a noun or noun phrase to give a reason for something:

Các giới từ because of, due to và owing to có thể đứng trước danh từ hoặc cụm danh từ để nêu lý do:

  • We were delayed because of an accident.

    Chúng tôi bị chậm vì tai nạn.

  • She was unable to run owing to / due to a leg injury.

    Cô ấy không chạy được do chấn thương chân.

  • We have less money to spend owing to / due to budget cuts.

    Chúng tôi có ít tiền chi tiêu hơn do cắt giảm ngân sách.

Note that we don’t use because alone before a noun or noun phrase:

Lưu ý không dùng because một mình trước danh từ hoặc cụm danh từ:

  • We were delayed because there was an accident. (not … because an accident.)

    Chúng tôi bị chậm vì có tai nạn.

In current English we usually avoid owing to directly after a form of be:

Trong tiếng Anh hiện đại, ta thường tránh dùng owing to ngay sau be:

  • The company’s success is due to the new director. (not … is owing to …)

    Thành công của công ty là nhờ giám đốc mới.

However, owing to is used after be + a degree adverb such as entirely, largely, mainly, partly:

Tuy nhiên, owing to được dùng sau be + trạng từ mức độ như entirely, largely, mainly, partly:

  • The low election turnout was partly due to / owing to the bad weather.

    Tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu thấp một phần do thời tiết xấu.

We can often use either it was due to … that or it was owing to … that:

Thường có thể dùng it was due to … that hoặc it was owing to … that:

  • It was owing to his encouragement that she applied for the job. (or It was due to … that)

    Nhờ anh ấy động viên mà cô ấy nộp đơn xin việc.

D. for and with + noun phrase

D. for và with + cụm danh từ

We can use for and with followed by a noun phrase to give a reason:

Có thể dùng for và with + cụm danh từ để nêu lý do:

  • She was looking all the better for her stay in hospital. (= ‘as a result of’)

    Trông cô ấy khá hơn hẳn nhờ đợt nằm viện.

  • With so many people ill, the meeting was cancelled. (= ‘as a result of there being’)

    Vì có quá nhiều người ốm, cuộc họp bị hủy.

mcq.question: We must be near the beach, ___ I can hear the waves.
mcq.full: We must be near the beach, because I can hear the waves.
mcq.vi: Chắc mình gần bãi biển rồi, vì tôi nghe thấy tiếng sóng.
mcq.expl:
as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + clause give a reason; because is most common in speech; since (= because) is formal; seeing that / as is informal.
as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + mệnh đề nêu lý do; because phổ biến nhất trong văn nói; since (= because) trang trọng; seeing that / as thân mật.
Điểm ngữ pháp: because + mệnh đề.
mcq.key: We must be near the beach, ___ I can hear the waves.|because

mcq.expl:
as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + clause give a reason; because is most common in speech; since (= because) is formal; seeing that / as is informal.
as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + mệnh đề nêu lý do; because phổ biến nhất trong văn nói; since (= because) trang trọng; seeing that / as thân mật.
Điểm ngữ pháp: seeing that (thân mật).
mcq.key: We could go and visit Natalia, ___ we have to drive past her house anyway.|seeing that

mcq.expl:
as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + clause give a reason; because is most common in speech; since (= because) is formal; seeing that / as is informal.

as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + mệnh đề nêu lý do; because phổ biến nhất trong văn nói; since (= because) trang trọng; seeing that / as thân mật.

as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + clause give a reason; because is most common in speech; since (= because) is formal; seeing that / as is informal.

mcq.question: You should never walk under a ladder ___ it’s supposed to be unlucky.
mcq.full: You should never walk under a ladder because it’s supposed to be unlucky.

as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + clause give a reason; because is most common in speech; since (= because) is formal; seeing that / as is informal.
as / because / since / seeing that / seeing as + mệnh đề nêu lý do; because phổ biến nhất trong văn nói; since (= because) trang trọng; seeing that / as thân mật.

mcq.question: We must begin planning now, ___ the future may bring unexpected changes.
mcq.full: We must begin planning now, for the future may bring unexpected changes.
mcq.vi: Chúng ta phải bắt đầu lập kế hoạch ngay, bởi tương lai có thể mang đến thay đổi bất ngờ.
mcq.expl:
Formal for (never at the start), in that, inasmuch as (clarify with detail).
Trang trọng: for (không đứng đầu câu), in that, inasmuch as (làm rõ bằng chi tiết).
Điểm ngữ pháp: for (trang trọng) = because.
mcq.key: We must begin planning now, ___ the future may bring unexpected changes.|for

mcq.question: The film is unusual ___ it features only four actors.
mcq.full: The film is unusual in that it features only four actors.
mcq.vi: Bộ phim khác thường ở chỗ chỉ có bốn diễn viên.
mcq.expl:
Formal for (never at the start), in that, inasmuch as (clarify with detail).
Trang trọng: for (không đứng đầu câu), in that, inasmuch as (làm rõ bằng chi tiết).
Điểm ngữ pháp: in that làm rõ bằng chi tiết.
mcq.key: The film is unusual ___ it features only four actors.|in that

mcq.question: Clara and I have quite an easy life, ___ neither of us has to work too hard.
mcq.full: Clara and I have quite an easy life, inasmuch as neither of us has to work too hard.
mcq.vi: Clara và tôi sống khá thoải mái, ở chỗ không ai phải làm việc quá vất vả.
mcq.expl:
Formal for (never at the start), in that, inasmuch as (clarify with detail).
Trang trọng: for (không đứng đầu câu), in that, inasmuch as (làm rõ bằng chi tiết).
Điểm ngữ pháp: inasmuch as.
mcq.key: Clara and I have quite an easy life, ___ neither of us has to work too hard.|inasmuch as

mcq.question: We were delayed ___ an accident.
mcq.full: We were delayed because of an accident.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi bị chậm vì tai nạn.
mcq.expl:
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: because of + cụm danh từ.
mcq.key: We were delayed ___ an accident.|because of

mcq.question: We were delayed because ___ an accident.
mcq.full: We were delayed because there was an accident.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi bị chậm vì có tai nạn.
mcq.expl:
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: because + mệnh đề (không dùng because + danh từ).
mcq.key: We were delayed because ___ an accident.|there was

mcq.question: She was unable to run ___ a leg injury.

because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).

mcq.full: The company’s success is due to the new director.
mcq.vi: Thành công của công ty là nhờ giám đốc mới.
mcq.expl:
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sau be → due to (không dùng owing to).
mcq.key: The company’s success is ___ the new director.|due to

mcq.question: It was ___ his encouragement that she applied for the job.
mcq.full: It was owing to his encouragement that she applied for the job.
mcq.vi: Nhờ anh ấy động viên mà cô ấy nộp đơn xin việc.
mcq.expl:
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It was owing to / due to … that.
mcq.key: It was ___ his encouragement that she applied for the job.|owing to

mcq.question: The cancellation of the competition is ___ lack of interest.
mcq.full: The cancellation of the competition is due to lack of interest.
mcq.vi: Cuộc thi bị hủy là do thiếu người quan tâm.
mcq.expl:
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).

mcq.full: It’s likely that the mistake was due to human error.
mcq.vi: Rất có thể lỗi đó là do sơ suất của con người.
mcq.expl:
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sau be → due to.
mcq.key: It’s likely that the mistake was ___ human error.|due to

mcq.full: I had to drive in dark glasses because of the bright sunlight.

because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).

because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).

mcq.expl:
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase (not because + noun); after be use due to, not owing to (unless be + entirely / largely / partly …).
because of / due to / owing to + cụm danh từ (không dùng because + danh từ); sau be dùng due to, không dùng owing to (trừ be + entirely / largely / partly …).
